SELECT message.id, message.sender_user_id, users.nickname AS sender_nickname, message.type, message.content, message.created_at, attachment.id AS attachment_id, attachment.content_type AS attachment_content_type, attachment.width AS attachment_width, attachment.height AS attachment_height, attachment.byte_size AS attachment_byte_size, NULL AS attachment_file_name, users.avatar AS sender_avatar, users.deleted_at AS sender_deleted_at, NULL AS transfer_status FROM chat_message message JOIN app_user users ON users.id = message.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN chat_attachment attachment ON attachment.message_id = message.id WHERE message.group_id = #{groupId} AND message.id = #{messageId} AND message.sender_user_id = #{senderUserId} AND message.type IN ('IMAGE', 'TEXT')
mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.sequence_number, m.sender_user_id, users.nickname AS sender_nickname, m.type, m.content, m.created_at, COALESCE(attachment.id, file_attachment.id, delivery.message_id) AS attachment_id, COALESCE(attachment.content_type, 'application/octet-stream') AS attachment_content_type, attachment.width AS attachment_width, attachment.height AS attachment_height, COALESCE(attachment.byte_size, file_attachment.byte_size, delivery.byte_size) AS attachment_byte_size, COALESCE(file_attachment.file_name, delivery.file_name) AS attachment_file_name, users.avatar AS sender_avatar, users.deleted_at AS sender_deleted_at, CASE WHEN delivery.pending_until > now() THEN 'PENDING' WHEN delivery.message_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'FAILED' END AS transfer_status FROM chat_message m JOIN app_user users ON users.id = m.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN chat_attachment attachment ON attachment.message_id = m.id LEFT JOIN chat_file_attachment file_attachment ON file_attachment.message_id = m.id LEFT JOIN chat_file_delivery delivery ON delivery.message_id = m.id
